verdict.rationale: The docs mention 'Automate tasks with Shortcuts' (macos-docs-19), which in reality supports event-based automations, but the evidence pack gives no detail on triggers, event types, or automation workflows, nor any independent confirmation of this working well. Missing for 10: documentation of specific event triggers (time, location, app launch, NFC, etc.), examples of automation rules, and independent/hands-on validation of the automation feature.
